who_preterm_lbw.source: WHO recommendations for care of the preterm or low-birth-weight infant (2022)

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Kangaroo mother care (KMC) is recommended as routine care for all preterm or low-birth-weight infants. KMC can be initiated in the health-care facility or at home and should be given for 8–24 hours per day (as many hours as possible). (Strong recommendation, high-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 建议将袋鼠式护理（KMC）作为所有早产或低出生体重婴儿的常规护理。KMC可以在医疗机构或家中启动，应每天进行8-24小时（尽可能多的小时数）。（强烈推荐，高确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Kangaroo mother care (KMC) for preterm or low-birth-weight infants should be started as soon as possible after birth. (Strong recommendation, high-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 早产或低出生体重儿应尽可能在出生后立即开始袋鼠式护理。 (强烈推荐，高确定性证据)

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Mother’s own milk is recommended for feeding of preterm or low-birth-weight (LBW) infants, including very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very LBW (< 1.5 kg) infants. (Strong recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 建议为早产或低出生体重（LBW）婴儿，包括极早产（< 32周妊娠）或极低体重（< 1.5 kg）婴儿，喂养母乳。（强烈推荐，低确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: When mother’s own milk is not available, donor human milk may be considered for feeding of preterm or low-birth-weight (LBW) infants, including very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very LBW (< 1.5 kg) infants. (Conditional recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 当母亲自身的母乳不可用时，可以考虑使用捐赠人乳喂养早产或低出生体重（LBW）婴儿，包括极早产（< 32周妊娠）或极低体重（< 1.5 kg）婴儿。（条件推荐，中等确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Multicomponent fortification of human milk is not routinely recommended for all preterm or low-birth-weight (LBW) infants but may be considered for very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very LBW (< 1.5 kg) infants who are fed mother’s own milk or donor human milk. (Conditional recommendation, low-to-moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 不常规推荐对所有早产或低出生体重（LBW）婴儿进行多成分母乳强化，但对于喂养母亲自己的母乳或捐赠人乳的极早产（< 32周妊娠）或极低体重（< 1.5 kg）婴儿，可以考虑进行多成分母乳强化。（条件推荐，低至中等确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: When mother’s own milk and donor human milk are not available, nutrient-enriched preterm formula may be considered for very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very low-birth-weight (< 1.5 kg) infants. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 当母亲自身的母乳和捐赠人乳不可用时，可考虑为极早产（< 32周妊娠）或极低出生体重（< 1.5公斤）的婴儿使用营养强化早产儿配方奶粉。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Preterm and low-birth-weight (LBW) infants, including very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) and very LBW (< 1.5 kg) infants, should be fed as early as possible from the first day after birth. Infants who are able to breastfeed should be put to the breast as soon as possible after birth. Infants who are unable to breastfeed should be given expressed mother’s own milk as soon as it becomes available. If mother’s own milk is not available, donor human milk should be given wherever possible. (Strong recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 早产和低出生体重（LBW）婴儿，包括极早产（< 32周妊娠）和极低出生体重（< 1.5 kg）婴儿，应尽可能在出生后的第一天开始喂养。能够母乳喂养的婴儿应尽可能在出生后立即哺乳。无法母乳喂养的婴儿应尽可能在母乳可用时给予母乳。如果母乳不可用，应尽可能提供捐赠人乳。（强烈推荐，中等确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.topic_zh: 按计划喂养与回应式喂养
recommendations.recommendation_en: Scheduled feeding may be considered rather than responsive feeding for preterm infants born before 34 weeks’ gestation, until the infant is discharged. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 对于出生孕周小于34周的早产儿，在婴儿出院前，可以考虑按计划喂养而非应需喂养。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Fast and slow advancement of feeding In preterm or low-birth-weight (LBW) infants, including very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very LBW (< 1.5 kg) infants, who need to be fed by an alternative feeding method to breastfeeding (e.g. gastric tube feeding or cup feeding), feed volumes can be increased by up to 30 ml/kg per day. (Conditional recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 早产或低出生体重（LBW）婴儿，包括极早产（< 32周妊娠）或极低体重（< 1.5 kg）婴儿，如需采用非母乳喂养的替代喂养方法（例如胃管喂养或杯喂养），可每日增加喂养量至30 ml/kg。 （条件推荐，中等确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Preterm or low-birth-weight infants should be exclusively breastfed until 6 months of age. (Strong recommendation, very- low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 早产或低出生体重婴儿应纯母乳喂养至6个月大。（强烈推荐，非常低确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Enteral iron supplementation is recommended for human milk-fed preterm or low-birth-weight infants who are not receiving iron from another source. (Strong recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 建议对未从其他来源获取铁的母乳喂养的早产儿或低出生体重儿进行肠内铁剂补充。（强烈推荐，中等确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Enteral zinc supplementation may be considered for human milk-fed preterm or low-birth-weight infants who are not receiving zinc from another source. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 对于未从其他来源获得锌补充的母乳喂养的早产儿或低出生体重儿，可以考虑肠内锌补充。 (条件推荐，低确定性证据)

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Enteral vitamin D supplementation may be considered for human milk-fed preterm or low-birth-weight infants who are not receiving vitamin D from another source. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 可考虑为未从其他来源获得维生素D的人乳喂养的早产儿或低出生体重儿进行肠内维生素D补充。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Enteral vitamin A supplementation may be considered for human milk-fed very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very low-birth-weight (< 1.5 kg) infants who are not receiving vitamin A from another source. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 可考虑为未从其他来源获得维生素A的人乳喂养的极低出生体重（<1.5公斤）或极早产（<32周妊娠）婴儿提供肠内维生素A补充。 (条件推荐，低确定性证据)

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Probiotics may be considered for human-milk-fed very preterm infants (< 32 weeks’ gestation). (Conditional recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 对于母乳喂养的极低出生体重儿（<32周妊娠），可以考虑使用益生菌。（条件推荐，中等确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 预防与促进性护理 (Preventive and promotive care)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Application of topical oil to the body of preterm or low-birth-weight infants may be considered. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 可以考虑对早产或低出生体重婴儿的身体应用局部油剂。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 并发症护理 (Care for complications)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) therapy is recommended in preterm infants with clinical signs of respiratory distress syndrome. (Strong recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 对于有呼吸窘迫综合征临床表现的早产儿，推荐使用持续正压通气（CPAP）治疗。（强烈推荐，中等确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 并发症护理 (Care for complications)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) therapy may be considered immediately after birth for very preterm infants (< 32 weeks’ gestation), with or without respiratory distress. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 对于极早产儿（<32周妊娠），无论是否有呼吸窘迫，可以考虑在出生后立即进行持续正压通气（CPAP）治疗。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 并发症护理 (Care for complications)
recommendations.recommendation_en: For preterm infants who need continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) therapy, bubble CPAP may be considered rather than other pressure sources (e.g. ventilator CPAP). (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 对于需要持续正压通气（CPAP）治疗的早产儿，可以考虑使用气泡CPAP而不是其他压力源（例如，呼吸机CPAP）。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 并发症护理 (Care for complications)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Caffeine is recommended for the treatment of apnoea in preterm infants. (Strong recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 推荐使用咖啡因治疗早产儿呼吸暂停。 (强烈推荐，中等确定性证据)

recommendations.domain: 并发症护理 (Care for complications)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Caffeine is recommended for the extubation of preterm infants born before 34 weeks’ gestation. (Strong recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 推荐使用咖啡因对出生前34周妊娠的早产儿进行拔管。 (强烈推荐，中等确定性证据)

recommendations.domain: 并发症护理 (Care for complications)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Caffeine may be considered for the prevention of apnoea in preterm infants born before 34 weeks’ gestation. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 对于出生前34周妊娠的早产儿，可以考虑使用咖啡因预防呼吸暂停。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 家庭参与与支持 (Family involvement and support)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Family involvement in the routine care of preterm or low-birth-weight infants in health-care facilities is recommended. (Strong recommendation, low- to moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 建议在医疗机构中，家庭参与早产或低出生体重儿的常规护理。 (强烈推荐，低至中等确定性证据)

recommendations.domain: 家庭参与与支持 (Family involvement and support)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Families of preterm or low-birth-weight infants should be given extra support to care for their infants, starting in health-care facilities from birth and continued during follow-up post-discharge. The support may include education, counselling and discharge preparation from health workers, and peer support. (Conditional recommendation, very-low-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 早产或低出生体重儿的家庭应得到额外的支持以照顾他们的婴儿，从出生开始在医疗机构开始，并在出院后的随访期间持续。这种支持可能包括来自医务人员的教育、咨询和出院准备，以及同伴支持。（条件推荐，非常低确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 家庭参与与支持 (Family involvement and support)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Home visits by trained health workers are recommended to support families to care for their preterm or low-birth-weight infant. (Strong recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 建议由经过培训的健康工作者进行家庭访问，以支持家庭照顾他们的早产或低出生体重婴儿。（强烈推荐，中等确定性证据）

recommendations.domain: 家庭参与与支持 (Family involvement and support)
recommendations.recommendation_en: Parental leave and entitlements should address the special needs of mothers, fathers and other primary caregivers of preterm or low-birth-weight infants. (Good practice statement)
recommendations.recommendation_zh: 产假和福利应满足早产或低出生体重婴儿的母亲、父亲和其他主要护理者的特殊需求。（良好实践声明）

china_screening.title_zh: 新生儿遗传代谢病筛查（足跟血）
china_screening.source: 《新生儿疾病筛查管理办法》（原卫生部令第64号）及各地新技术规范
points: 全国筛查病种：先天性甲状腺功能减低症（CH）、苯丙酮尿症（PKU）等新生儿遗传代谢病；各省可按本地情况增加病种（如先天性肾上腺皮质增生症 CAH、葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶缺乏症 G6PD 等）
采血时间：出生 72 小时后、吃饱奶（至少 6-8 次）后由助产机构采集足跟血制成干血片；早产儿、提前出院者需追踪采血，最迟不宜超过出生后 20 天
程序：血片采集 → 送检 → 实验室检测 → 阳性病例确诊和治疗
意义：患儿出生时大多外观正常，出生 3-6 个月才逐渐出现症状；早筛查早治疗可避免智力低下、发育落后等不可逆损害
家长须知：筛查遵循知情同意原则；初筛阳性不等于确诊，需按通知尽快复查确诊

china_screening.source: 《新生儿疾病筛查管理办法》（原卫生部令第64号）
points: 初筛：出生后 48 小时至出院前，用耳声发射（OAE）或自动听性脑干反应（AABR）检测
复筛：初筛未通过者需在出生 42 天内复筛
程序：初筛 → 复筛 → 阳性病例确诊和治疗
NICU 住院高危儿建议直接采用 AABR
意义：永久性听力损失患儿在出生 6 个月内开始科学干预和康复训练，有助于语言认知正常发育

china_screening.title_zh: 新生儿先天性心脏病筛查（心脏听诊+经皮脉搏血氧饱和度）
china_screening.source: 新生儿先天性心脏病筛查项目（国家卫生健康委妇幼司，2018 年起全国推广）
points: 筛查时间：出生后 6-72 小时（出院前）
筛查方法：心脏杂音听诊 + 经皮脉搏血氧饱和度测定（无创）
筛查阳性者：1 周内转诊至诊断机构做超声心动图明确诊断
确诊患儿转诊至治疗机构治疗并随访
筛查需监护人知情同意
